cases.question: How do Mapletree Logistics Trust and CapitaLand Ascendas REIT compare on Scope 1?
cases.measures: The rule untested in v1 and v2: when two companies' reporting years differ, say so. Both are REITs, so sector is not the difference; MLT's financial year runs 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 and CLAR's 2025 is a calendar year. The agent states both verified figures with their periods, says the years do not match, and does not rank.
cases.pass_rule: Both verified Scope 1 figures are stated with their own units and periods; the reply says the two reporting years are different (read by hand: the checks find a period and a difference term, not the statement that the years differ); no ranking and no offer to compare.

cases.question: What were Frasers Logistics & Commercial Trust's market-based Scope 2 emissions in FY2025?
cases.measures: A figure read by code from an issuer's workbook (new in Tier 3 Block 1): the agent states it as printed, in the workbook's unit, with FLCT's October-to-September year, and cites the workbook's sheet and cell rather than a page.
cases.pass_rule: The verified figure is stated in ktCO2e with the period 1 Oct 2024 to 30 Sep 2025 and its sheet-and-cell citation (the citation read by hand); no figure from anywhere else.

cases.question: What were ST Engineering's Scope 1 emissions in 2025?
cases.measures: The first caveat (Tier 3 Block 1, proposal 1): ST Engineering's footnote that the last three months of 2025 are estimates. The caveat is attached in code, so the reply carries it whatever the model writes; the case records whether the model also says the figure is partly estimated. Runs only after the author's caveat is applied.
cases.pass_rule: The verified figure is stated with its unit ('000 tCO2e); the reply ends with the attached caveat (code); whether the model's own words say 'estimate' is read by hand and reported apart.

cases.question: What are FLCT's total Scope 3 emissions?
cases.measures: Rows read from a workbook where only per-region totals are verified: FLCT's databook prints a Scope 3 total for each region, and the all-regions table was left out (its unit is unclear). The agent says Carbon R holds no verified FLCT-wide Scope 3 total, gives the per-region figures as printed, and does not sum them.
cases.pass_rule: The reply says no verified FLCT-wide (all-regions) Scope 3 total is held and gives the regional totals as printed, each labelled by region, with no sum (a summed figure is not any verified figure, so no_unverified_figures fails on it; the 'no FLCT-wide total' statement is read by hand).
